prompt: Company profile: Distribution company in Allentown, Pennsylvania; 200 employees at a single distribution center. Situation: The company hired a roofing contractor to replace the 30-foot-high flat roof. The contract runs six weeks. The company's own maintenance staff will periodically go onto the roof to escort the contractor and inspect progress, and they also access rooftop HVAC units for routine maintenance year-round. Ask: Identify the compliance obligations this situation creates or affects for the compliance-obligations register. For each obligation: state the requirement, its source, its applicability to this company, the ISO clause it maps to (ISO 14001 6.1.3 / ISO 45001 6.1.3), and how and when compliance should be evaluated (9.1.2).
response:
